commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+3' 0 - 4 GOAL! Julian Alvarez finds himself with the ball at his feet in space after a lightning counter attack. He looks and up slides the ball to Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid), who coolly slots the ball past the keeper from close in. It’s 0:4.
90+2' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' 0 - 3 GOAL! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) runs onto a pass from Conor Gallagher after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from mid range. It’s now 0:3.
89' Substitution. Cristhian Stuani walks off the pitch and Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) comes on as a substitute.
87' 0 - 2 Goal! Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Vladyslav Krapyvtsov and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 0:2.
87' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes it short.
86' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
86' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
85' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
85' Giuliano Simeone almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
83' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
83' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but Juan Musso comes off his line to gather the ball.
82' Oriol Romeu (Girona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Juan Musso, who smothers the ball.
81' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) dribbles into the box, but Vladyslav Krapyvtsov is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
80' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
78' It's time for a substitution. Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) comes on in place of Rodrigo de Paul.
77' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
74' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid).

74' A pass into the box finds Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the roof of the net, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Vladyslav Krapyvtsov denies him. Atl. Madrid get a corner.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Oriol Romeu (Girona) will replace Arthur Melo.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Abel Ruiz (Girona) replaces Yangel Herrera.
70' Diego Simeone has decided to substitute Samuel Lino and he is replaced by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid).
70' Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Koke.
70' Total attempts – 2:12. The current number of shots on goal is 1:6.
70' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
68' 0 - 1 Goal! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) scores after an assist by Rodrigo de Paul that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:1.

65' A pass travels right across the box to Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom left corner, but Vladyslav Krapyvtsov denies him with a decent save.
64' Substitution. Juanpe (Girona) replaces Alejandro Frances.
64' Substitution. Portu is replaced by Ivan Martin (Girona).
62' Diego Simeone prepares a substitution. Nahuel Molina is replaced by Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid).
62' The referee signals a substitution. Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) is brought on as a substitute for Antoine Griezmann.
61' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
60' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

59' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
58' Portu (Girona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
57' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
56' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Vladyslav Krapyvtsov intercepts the ball.
55' The attendance is 11546.
53' Arnau Martinez (Girona) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.

50' A neat pass is well received by Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot.
47' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find Julian Alvarez, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Girona.
46' The whistle blows and Jesus Manzano starts the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' Koke (Atl. Madrid) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

45+5' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes the resulting free kick from the edge of the box. His effort heads for the bottom left corner, but Vladyslav Krapyvtsov denies him. Atl. Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

45+3' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
45+2' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Atl. Madrid will take a free kick.
45+1' Diego Simeone isn't happy on the touchline after referee Jesus Manzano shows him a yellow card.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
45' Atl. Madrid are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
40' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
35' The game is interrupted.
35' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.

33' Good touch by Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) as he receives a great pass and attempts to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range strike. Unfortunately for him, the effort misses the net and flies well wide to the right.
33' Koke (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

32' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
31' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 2:5. Shots on target – 1:2.
30' Yangel Herrera (Girona) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jesus Manzano signals.
28' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
26' The referee blows for a cooling break.
24' It could have been a good chance to score! Yaser Asprilla (Girona) fails to release Cristhian Stuani with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
24' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
22' Arnau Martinez (Girona) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
21' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.

18' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom left corner. Vladyslav Krapyvtsov guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.

17' Yangel Herrera (Girona) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
17' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) will deliver the corner kick.

16' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Girona.
15' The possession of the ball – 41:59.

14' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the bottom left corner, but Vladyslav Krapyvtsov was alert and the score remains the same.
14' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

13' Koke (Atl. Madrid) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. The ball goes out for a corner. Atl. Madrid can continue in their attacking effort.
13' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
12' What a miskick by Daley Blind (Girona). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
11' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) plays a lovely through ball to Marcos Llorente, but he can't beat Vladyslav Krapyvtsov and loses the ball.
9' Alejandro Frances (Girona) plays a terrific long ball forward to Yaser Asprilla, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
7' Yaser Asprilla (Girona) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
6' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
6' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
5' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) sent a pass onto Julian Alvarez, who didn't get a chance to finish.
4' Cristhian Stuani (Girona) tries to find Portu, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
2' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick to Girona.
2' Atl. Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Atl. Madrid will take the kick-off.
Jesus Manzano got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
